name: Mesa PanVK
author: abhay-byte
description: PanVK, the Mesa Vulkan driver for Arm Mali GPUs, on the mali_kbase kernel driver: Bifrost JM v6/v7, Valhall JM v9 and CSF v10-v14 in one universal .so, supporting v6 to v14. v15 (Mali-G2) is not fully supported. Mesa 26.3.0-devel development build (git-62ba524b64). Bundled in this APK.
